_comment: Map categories and retailers to Discord channels and roles. Set channel IDs and role IDs after creating your Discord server.

retailerChannels._comment: Optional per-retailer channels (paid tier). If set, alerts go here instead of category channel.

roles._comment: Role IDs to ping. Members subscribe to roles for games/retailers they want.

webhooks._comment: Webhook URLs as fallback if bot can't reach a channel. Format: category or retailer ID -> webhook URL.
